seoTitle: Payment Terms Due Date Calculator (Net 30, EOM)
metaDescription: Find the invoice due date for net 14, 30, 60 or end-of-month terms, with days left or overdue.
intro: Due date from the invoice date and a payment term.
why:
Terms such as net 30 and 30 days end of month sound alike but give different dates. The tool shows the exact due date and weekday.

You can move weekend due dates to Monday if your policy does. Public holidays are not considered.
howTo: Choose a term or custom days.
Read the due date and days left.

faq.a: Payment due 30 calendar days after the invoice date.
Count 30 days then move to the end of that month.
